name: POST /api/leadflow/channel-decision/bulk - the same question for many subjects
description:
Composes a decision per entry and returns them in request order, with allow/review/denied counts.

EVERY ENTRY IS VALIDATED BEFORE ANY DECISION IS COMPOSED. A malformed entry at position 400 would otherwise leave 399 decisions already written to the ledger for a request that then answers 400 - records of decisions nobody asked for, attached to a call that failed.

CAPPED AT 500 WITH A STATED NUMBER, never a silent truncation. Answering 200 for the first 500 of 5,000 would let a campaign send to the other 4,500 with no decision behind them at all, which is precisely the bypass this endpoint exists to prevent.

COMPOSED SEQUENTIALLY, not in parallel. Five hundred entries fired at once is two thousand simultaneous calls across four SDKs, which trips their rate limits and then the circuit breaker - turning a routine campaign check into an outage for every other feature sharing those SDKs.

Order is preserved so a caller can zip requests to decisions positionally rather than matching on subjectRef, which breaks the moment the same subject appears twice.

Behind authenticate and governed on message.send_approved. QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: Decides for several subjects and reports the verdict counts
NEGATIVE: one malformed entry rejects the WHOLE batch before anything is written
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer. Verified live: without authenticate the caller has no roles at all and governed() refuses with a message about the policy bundle, which points at the wrong thing entirely.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify

errorCases.message: requests must be a non-empty array
errorCases.when: requests is absent, not an array, empty, longer than 500 entries, or any entry is missing subjectRef or carries an unknown channel. The whole batch is refused so no partial ledger is written.

errorCases.message: No policy grants this action to the caller's roles.
errorCases.when: the caller's roles do not grant message.send_approved. NOT COVERED BY A DATASET for the same reason as above: the suite's single identity bridges to sales_rep, which holds this grant. Kept rather than deleted because it is a real response; verified live during development when the router was missing `authenticate` and every caller therefore had no roles at all.
